contract_plain_english: For the hyperbolic equation under study, take the Riemann problem with constant left state q_l on x < 0 and constant right state q_r on x > 0 initially. The q-Riemann symbol applied to these data denotes the state in its similarity solution along x/t = 0. This state is often used to define numerical fluxes [raw PDF page 27, printed page 5, Section 1.2.1 and equation (1.11); raw PDF page 33, printed page 11, Section 1.7 final paragraph]. The passage introduces notation and does not specify general existence or uniqueness conditions or a point-value convention at a stationary discontinuity [same defining paragraph].
